for bar, val in zip(bars, purchase_data.values):

ax6.set_ylabel('Income ($)')

from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', label='No Response'),

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
